// How long a processed event id is remembered. Retries of the same webhook arrive
// within seconds; this bounds memory on a long-running process.
// event id -> ts of the event, in insertion order (Map preserves it), so pruning can stop early.
// one listener for the NotificationSubscriber, one for the AuditLog
// retry ~1s later, outside any short time window
// the audit log still sees every delivery

rationale: The diff removes the double subscription in the NotificationSubscriber constructor (the root cause the HACK comment named) and replaces the user/type time-window dedupe with proper event-id idempotency rather than widening the window, so the whole class of retries is handled. The payment.failed user+ops delivery path is untouched and a new test asserts the ops channel still receives it when the user has opted out.
